caution.para: This feature is in progress. Contrary to the description below the default is currently &no;, and the extension is not yet negotiated.

listitem.para: Whether to negotiate the IKEv2 downgrade-prevention extension (draft-ietf-ipsecme-ikev2-downgrade-prevention). Normally each peer authenticates only the IKE_SA_INIT message it sent; this extension additionally authenticates the message it received, so that tampering with either IKE_SA_INIT message causes the IKE_AUTH exchange to fail. IKEv2 only.

&auto;, the default, proposes the extension and uses it when the peer also supports it, otherwise falling back to standard IKEv2. &yes; additionally requires it: the connection fails if the peer does not agree. &no; neither proposes nor accepts it.

Protection applies only when both peers support the extension and at least one uncompromised authentication key is used; in particular it does not apply when both peers authenticate with the same pre-shared key.
